description: Two-turn eligibility conversation. Turn 2 is a 200 ms sub-300 ms burst: the app's min-burst filter drops it as noise (MIN_UTTERANCE_FRAMES=15), so the harness expects a turn with no response and records it as such rather than as a timeout fault (LLD T-6).

turns.text: What marks do I need to get into the B.Tech computer science programme?
